inputs.text: Vertical cinematic medium shot inside the same modern Chinese apartment study at evening. The same adult Chinese woman age 28 sits at a wooden desk beside an open laptop. One black smartphone lies face-down on the desk near her right hand; only its matte rear shell and small camera module are visible, never the display. She looks down toward the phone with slightly furrowed eyebrows and reaches toward its side edge. Premium handcrafted 3D plush doll film, soft flocked fabric, fine textile fibers, rounded adult chibi proportions, cold white practical light with a warm desk lamp, clean 9:16 composition. Exactly one phone, rear side toward camera, no visible screen, no interface, no generated text, natural hands.
